'''Assimilated Humans''' are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Zombies and Husks.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Zombie or Husk succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 5 Zombies/Husks have been assimilated.
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by [[Adapted Summoner|Adapted Summoners]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Humans are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, with a 20% chance to inflict [[Bleeding]] for 3 seconds.
* Assimilated Humans are able to open Wooden Doors and Fence Gates if they are between their target.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Human will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Humans are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Humans are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Human gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a Moving Flesh.
* If an Assimilated Human kills 5 Skeletons and is unable to turn into [[Moving Flesh]], it will evolve into a [[Host]].
* If an Assimilated Human gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into [[Moving Flesh]], it will evolve into a [[Feral Human]].
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Human will drop its [[Walking Human Head|Head]].
* In groups, Assimilated Humans will pace in circles. This occurrence initiates in a group of eight or more Assimilated Humans and stops once a target is found or five or less remain. This behavior serves no real purpose.{{Variants|count=1|Texture=Assimilated Human Variant.png|TextureDesc=has identical stats.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Humans, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Assimilated Humans have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

== ''Trivia'' ==
* A Variant of Assimilated Humans simply called in the Mod files as '''human1''' can spawn, equipped with its own Head. It simply acts as aesthetic.
* In the Mod's Files, there are textures of two unused Variants called '''human2''' and '''humannocturn'''. It is unknown why they were unused.
* While idle, there is a small chance its old idle sound plays.
